# MetaViewer
Linux desktop wall of browser and application capsules under human or agent control. Rust admits actions and journals outcomes; Electron/Vue renders admitted snapshots.
First read: AGENTS.md, then README.md.
One command for docs, code and findings: python3 route/route_query.py any "<question>"
Router: route/. Status: router unavailable. This status concerns only the older catalogue router, catalogue/protocol.json; use route/.
